typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		PRINCIPAL_BAL_AMT as string,
		CORPORATELEDGERACCOUNT as string,
		CLOSING_BAL_AMT as integer,
		BR_ACCOUNT_NM as string,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		TRADER as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		INTEREST_BAL_AMT as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		BR_BRANCH_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		PRINCIPAL_BAL_AMT as string,
		CORPORATELEDGERACCOUNT as string,
		CLOSING_BAL_AMT as integer,
		BR_ACCOUNT_NM as string,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		TRADER as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		INTEREST_BAL_AMT as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		BR_BRANCH_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PRINCIPAL_BAL_AMT,
		CORPORATELEDGERACCOUNT,
		CLOSING_BAL_AMT,
		BR_ACCOUNT_NM,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD,
		TRADER,
		EFFDATE,
		INTEREST_BAL_AMT,
		CLIENT_NBR,
		BR_BRANCH_CD),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
